poses.interpolation: linear position, slerp rotation between the two raw samples around cloud time + lag
poses.gap_fill_note: Only the gen3 body needs filling: 230 of 231 frames of ep04 (raw samples 16.83 s apart) and 53 frames of ep05 (1.84 s apart). max_gap_s is the smallest round value that covers both.

correction.method: refine_spatula_trajectories.py (per-frame partial-view ICP + se3_pose_fusion error-state Kalman with RTS smoother), episode18_dynamics_spatula_icp_final settings, every 10th cloud; frames with source_code > 0
correction.uncorrected: ep04_right_edge_cut gen3_spathla (no OptiTrack in the episode, so no Kalman estimate)
